about: The questions of the old-answer test (step 1.7 of Genter's open-source plan): one per pair of a document that says of itself that it is replaced and the document that replaces it, in the archives bench/repos picked, asked so that the current answer lives in the replacing document. DriftBench's deprecated kind is read from bench/drift/questions.json by run.mjs. Each question here was written from both documents at the commit below and waits for a person's review: "reviewed" says who checked it.

questions.question: How long must a deprecated Python feature keep warning before it can be removed?
questions.pair: peps/pep-0005.rst says "Superseded-By: 387" in its header (the rfc reader's mark names PEP 387 by number, not by place)
questions.current_says: Wait for the warning to appear in at least two minor Python releases.

questions.question: How are the browser's UI tools delivered to the agent sidecar and called by it in Jaeger's AI chat?
questions.pair: docs/rfc/0002-ai-gateway-contextual-tools.md says in its Status line "the §5 tool-routing decision is superseded by [RFC 0008](./0008-ai-gateway-mcp-tool-routing.md)" (the banners reader's mark links the replacing RFC)
questions.current_says: Over the gateway-hosted, turn-scoped MCP endpoint, UI tools named ui__<name>; RFC 0002 chose an ACP extension method.
questions.note: RFC 0002 says only its §5 is superseded; Genter's mark is on the whole document, as quoted.

questions.question: Which address does an external MCP client such as Cursor use to reach Jaeger's MCP tools?
questions.pair: docs/rfc/0012-mcp-server-extension.md says in its Status line "tool routing superseded by [RFC 0008](./0008-ai-gateway-mcp-tool-routing.md)" (the banners reader's mark links the replacing RFC)
questions.current_says: The shared /api/ai/mcp/ path on the query port; RFC 0012 proposed a standalone extension on :16687.
questions.note: RFC 0012 says only its tool routing is superseded; Genter's mark is on the whole document, as quoted.
